_readme: EDITED BY HAND. No script or bot writes this file and nothing fetches it from another site. Each item links to a real outside story: copy the headline exactly as the publisher shows it, write the one-line summary yourself in neutral words from the headline or the story's free text only (never from behind a paywall), set paywalled to true for subscriber stories, and keep 5 items at most, newest first. Never add On3 or 247Sports links found by a bot (their terms ban automation); only links Jackson picks by hand. An empty items list hides the module. See tools/README.md.
_contact_note: PLACEHOLDER: Jackson still has to pick the project email for removal requests. While contact is an empty string the removal line is hidden; the module still shows.

items.title: ACC Announces Volleyball Players of the Week
items.summary: SMU setter Hannah Beauford shared the ACC's Setter of the Week honor after sweeps of Clemson and Georgia Tech.

items.title: No. 1 SMU men's soccer clinches a share of school's first ACC regular-season title
items.summary: The top-ranked Mustangs secured at least a share of SMU's first ACC regular-season title in men's soccer.

items.title: Kevin Jennings breaks SMU's TD passing record in win over Cal
items.summary: Jennings threw his 73rd career touchdown pass, passing Tanner Mordecai for the school record, as SMU beat Cal 59-20.

items.title: SMU scores 42 unanswered second-half points in revenge game against Cal
items.summary: The student paper's recap of SMU coming back from a 20-17 halftime deficit to beat Cal.

items.title: Oppliger Sweeps Diving Events, SMU Wraps Dual Meet At No. 18 Arizona State
items.summary: Macey Oppliger won both diving events and Maddy Parker won the 50 free as SMU women's swimming and diving met Arizona State in Tempe.
